basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go trainer based in Toronto, Canada. I've been playing since the game launched and love organizing raids and connecting with other players worldwide. Aside from Pokémon, I'm a big fan of true crime podcasts and often tune into Casefile. Weekends are mostly spent exploring new areas in search of rare Pokémon or enjoying live music at local venues. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom of spontaneous travel and adventure. My typical online hours are late evenings and early mornings, perfect for catching global events and raids.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of Pokémon Go, acquired through years of playing and participating in local and online communities. My interest in true crime stems from a long-time hobby of listening to podcasts, which has given me an informal education on famous cases and investigative techniques. Professionally, my graphic design skills are self-taught, honed through online courses and practical experience working with clients.
